title: Understanding the Loss Function
text: The loss function given is $$L(hat_y,y)=hat_y-\theta_2 y$$. This function measures the difference between the predicted value $$hat_y$$ and the actual value $$y$$, scaled by $$\theta_2$$.

title: Calculate the Predicted Value
text: Using the model $$hat_y=\theta_2 \theta_1 x$$, calculate the predicted value $$hat_y$$ using the given values: $$\theta_1=3$$, $$\theta_2=pi$$, and $$x=2$$.

title: Compute the Gradient with Respect to $$\theta_2$$
text: To perform gradient descent, compute the gradient of the loss function with respect to $$\theta_2$$. Use the formula: $$gradient_{\theta,2}=partial_derivative(L,\theta_2)$$.

title: Update $$\theta_2$$
text: Using the gradient computed, update $$\theta_2$$ using the formula: $${\theta_2}^{t+1}={\theta_2}^t-\alpha gradient_{\theta,2}$$. Use $$alpha=0.5$$.
